name: Illustrative Transparency
definition: A transparency model combining uniform opacity ($\alpha_u$) from the transfer function and directional opacity ($\alpha_d$) from the style map, modulated by curvature and gradient magnitude to simulate the 100-percent-rule.
summary: Illustrative Transparency is a non-photorealistic technique that modulates opacity to simulate the 100-percent-rule, clarifying complex 3D structures by falling off near edges and increasing with distance.
